# hallpass_agent (Data Source)

Looks up an agent by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hallpass_agent" "claude_sre" {
  name = "claude-sre"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether it is enabled.
- `groups` (Set of String) Groups.
- `id` (String) Agent ID.
